replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation: To both parties: this is a RYDE_POOL trip, and that fact decides the case. Under POL-RD-12 the baseline for the route-deviation test is the matched pooled itinerary the platform computed at match time — trip_record.optimal_distance_km of 19.40 km on EV-TRIP-00113 — not the rider's solo Punggol-to-Raffles-Plain distance of 15.80 km (trip_record.solo_optimal_distance_km, carried on the record for reference only). The rider's 15.8 km figure is the wrong field, and a claim measured against it fails on that ground alone. The governing actual distance is the GPS trace (POL-RD-01): EV-GPS-00113 records trace_distance_km of 20.18 km, and the rounded 20.2 km on the trip record and the fare line may not be cited for the threshold test. Excess = 20.18 minus 19.40 = 0.78 km, or 4.02%. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to exceed BOTH 20% of optimal (3.88 km) AND 0.8 km absolute. 0.78 km clears neither limb — it misses the absolute gate by 20 metres — so no deviation is established and the rider's claim is not supported. The stop at Hougang is the matched co-rider pickup, which POL-RD-12 excludes from excess by name; the platform's own notification MSG-00113-001 on EV-CHAT-00113 told the rider at 18:42:04 that the pooled route now included one Hougang pickup and quoted 19.4 km, and the log shows it read at 18:42:31, before the 18:47:10 start. The driver's account (a second passenger matched at Hougang, driving the app route) is corroborated by that notification, by his contemporaneous message MSG-00113-003, and by the trace stop; his statement does not contradict the instruments. The trace is unimpaired (217 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps, 10-second cadence, max gap 0.0 s), so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) do not apply. No exculpatory clause is needed because no deviation exists: POL-RD-03 is not invoked (traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00113-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and could support no closure in any event), POL-RD-04 cannot run (no rider instruction in the chat log and every waypoint_hint is null), and POL-RD-05 has no amended endpoint or amended optimal distance. These are noted only because they were raised; none changes the outcome. No billing-integrity refund is due under POL-RD-09(4): EV-FARE-00113 is METERED on rate card RC-SG-2026Q3-RYDEPOOL, erp_gantries is empty, airport_surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, the line items reconcile, and a 3.00 pool discount was applied in the rider's favour. POL-RD-06 is not engaged — 0.78 km is far below the 8.0 km / 50% material gate — and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 471 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat-pattern uplift and no conduct referral arise. The rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d of 1, substantiated 0) imposes no enhanced corroboration burden under POL-RD-08, and every other profile field on either side is context only under POL-GEN-01. The $6.00 contested therefore stays where it is: NO_ACTION is party-relative, the rider's claim is not supported, and fare_breakdown.payment_status remains CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd at 0.00. Confidence 0.90, above the 0.70 policy floor; no escalation and no referral on this record.
